literature_design_bindings.boundary: Typed adoption is inspectable but is not proof of applicability. Human review must still compare the sealed source excerpt with the Planner's exact application and any declared divergence.

citations.application: Apply observational reporting standards to state the cohort, denominators, variable definitions, and descriptive-only interpretation.
citations.source_excerpt: Methodology: What must this study report for a reader to appraise it?; Are the analysis units independent?; Is a ratio measure enough to convey the finding?
citations.title: The Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (STROBE) statement: guidelines for reporting observational studies.

citations.application: Report the routinely collected database source and the reproducible extraction and variable-construction process.
citations.source_excerpt: Methodology: What extra reporting does routinely collected health data need?
citations.title: The REporting of studies Conducted using Observational Routinely-collected health Data (RECORD) statement.

citations.application: Treat phenotype classification as determined over the prespecified first 24 hours after ICU admission and keep interpretation limited to the resulting descriptive landmark population.
citations.divergence: No landmark survival estimator is fitted; the source informs temporal alignment of the descriptive classification.
citations.source_excerpt: Methodology: How is a post-baseline exposure classification analysed fairly?
citations.title: Analysis of survival by tumor response and other comparisons of time-to-event by outcome variables.

citations.application: Flag the post-ICU-admission exposure-ascertainment period as a limitation and avoid interpreting the grouped mortality proportions as ordinary baseline exposure effects.
citations.divergence: No causal or time-to-event effect estimate is attempted.
citations.source_excerpt: Methodology: When does follow-up start relative to when exposure is decided?
citations.title: Immortal time bias in pharmacoepidemiology.

novelty_review.claim_boundary: Candidate novelty only. The Agent may execute an approved analysis, but neither the plan nor manuscript may claim top-journal novelty until an independent appraisal is bound.

facts.remediation_boundary: Only agent_plan_revision findings may be fed to a fresh Planner without changing StudyContext authority. The other lanes require user authorization, new external evidence, or independent review.

scientific_capability.reason: The registered contracts permit a reportable claim ceiling; runtime execution, evidence, numeric and manuscript gates must still pass.

score_interpretation.content_completeness: Content score covers planned article roles only. Result richness and manuscript quality remain unassessed until evidence exists.
score_interpretation.figures: Figure score covers typed planned roles only. Rendered visual quality, labels, export integrity, and source-data fidelity are not assessed until execution.

findings.message: No dated retrieval source returned current literature for this plan.
findings.remediation: Run and retain a reproducible database search before claiming article-level prior-art coverage.

findings.message: No retrieved study passed all population, exposure, outcome, and design-excerpt checks as a direct comparator.
findings.remediation: Run a direct observational-comparator search stratum and record source-backed inclusion/exclusion decisions.

findings.authorization_question: Do you want to prespecify executable, study-family-appropriate sensitivity analyses in a new study version?
findings.message: The study-family playbook calls for robustness evidence, but no typed, executable sensitivity authority was prespecified for this study version.
findings.remediation: Issue a new user-reviewed sensitivity authority for a task-supported denominator, missingness/measurement, outcome-definition, timing, or model axis. Descriptive studies must not invent an effect-estimate replay grid.

findings.message: Without a direct comparator, the system cannot distinguish a genuinely novel design from a new database instantiation.
findings.remediation: Complete source-backed direct-comparator screening and a separate five-dimension novelty review before making novelty claims.
